name: Ara
description: The world's first self-driving IDE that proactively suggests next steps by reading open PRs, reviews, failing checks, Sentry alerts, and teammate activity. Features Autosuggest which surfaces the next useful thing to build before you ask.
community_quotes: Self-driving IDE for fast moving engineers
The IDE doesn't just wait for you to type a prompt - it actively looks at your codebase and suggests what to do next
When you're shipping a hundred pull requests a day, the hard questions are about orientation, not syntax

name: Kimi Code CLI
description: A terminal AI coding agent built in TypeScript by Moonshot AI. Features subagent architecture with Coder, Explore, and Plan sub-agents for next-gen agent workflows. MIT licensed open-source project.
community_quotes: Built with TypeScript and MIT licensed (open-source)
Terminal-native coding agent with subagent architecture
Can read and write code, execute shell commands, search files, and scrape web pages

name: TiDB Agent State Stack
description: Production-grade AI memory solution launched at SuperAI Summit Singapore. Provides AI agents with durable memory, persistent state, and continuous learning capabilities across sessions.
community_quotes: Provides durable memory, persistent state, and continuous learning
